What We Do

Revenue Grade Validation

We capture flight activity across all surveillance environments and transform it into validated, ICAO-aligned invoices that meet the standard of Revenue Grade Validation — every record defensible back to its source evidence. Governments gain real-time visibility across aviation, treasury, and audit stakeholders, supported by independent revenue verification and a performance-aligned service model.

The Intelligence Layer

Global Insight

— the intelligence engine behind AERO

Global Insight is the proprietary data intelligence layer that makes AERO possible. Processing 1B+ data points daily across multi-source surveillance, GI ingests flight activity at global scale in real time — then delivers a clean, auditable, evidentiary record to AERO for billing, reconciliation, and oversight.
GI Delivers
  • 1B+ data points processed daily across global airspace
  • Multi-source validation across ADS-B, Mode-S, radar, ACARS, and flight plans
  • Gap-filling architecture designed around imperfect surveillance
  • FIR attribution aligned to ICAO Annex 11 and FIXM standards
The Platform — AERO Airspace Enterprise Resource Optimization

Sovereign-Grade Revenue Operating System

AERO is the enterprise revenue operating system behind sovereign airspace. It ingests multiple independent surveillance and data sources, validates every flight to Revenue Grade Validation standards, and automates the complete invoice lifecycle from validated activity to collected revenue — giving governments end-to-end visibility across aviation, treasury, and audit functions.

AERO Delivers

  • Multi-source flight review and validation
  • Real-time billing and collection tracking
  • Faster collections cycle
  • Operator-level reconciliation
  • Role-based dashboards across aviation, treasury, and audit
  • Complete invoice lifecycle — issuance to collection to fund allocation
  • Multi-jurisdiction architecture — scales cleanly per CAA engagement

AERO Ensures

  • No manual processing gaps
  • No opaque collections
  • Full government visibility
  • Every invoice certified to Revenue Grade Validation
  • Automated coverage-gap resolution built into the core
  • Performance-aligned service model
  • Independent revenue verification
The Standard

Revenue Grade Validation

— the billing-defensibility standard

The RGV™ Mark

Invoices issued through AERO are stamped with the RGV™ mark — signaling to airline accounts payable teams that the charge is supported by a complete, auditable evidentiary chain.

Every invoice can be defended back to its source evidence.
What Revenue Grade Means
  1. Multi-source surveillance evidence for every flight
  2. Documented FIR entry/exit with timestamped methodology
  3. Gap-filling and anomaly handling that survive IATA challenge
  4. Complete identity chain: hex → registration → operator → liable entity
  5. Immutable audit log from raw data to issued invoice

Outcomes

Outcomes Delivered Under Government Oversight

Improvement in collection of existing revenues and the provision of regulatory oversight — under a framework the sovereign defines, monitors, and controls.

1.

NavPass improves revenue recovery and collection by turning verified flight activity into auditable, RGV™-certified invoices.

2.

Governments gain real-time visibility and full auditability across aviation, treasury, and audit stakeholders.

3.

NavPass creates a "revenue utility" that can be referenced by external investors and development lenders — without expanding public debt.

4.

All data, all revenue, and all control remain with the sovereign. NavPass operates as infrastructure — governments retain policy authority, dispute authority, and enforcement authority at every stage.

Our Mission

Our mission is to close the gap between airspace utilization and revenue realization — strengthening the financial foundations of sovereign aviation through validated data, defensible invoices, and sustained institutional oversight.

Where validated revenue strengthens nations, skies become safer to fly and prosperity takes lasting form.
